$comment: The tints, in display order. darkberry is the default palette (src/palette.json); every other key is a variant in src/variants/<key>.json and builds into each port's <key>/ subfolder. `swatch` names the palette colour that stands for the tint on README badges.

darkberry.name: Darkberry
darkberry.note: The default. Wine-dark plum, straight from the paint can.

lingonberry.name: Lingonberry
lingonberry.note: Backgrounds steeped in raspberry red. The one that looks like it won the fight.

cloudberry.name: Cloudberry
cloudberry.note: Backgrounds warmed toward ripe peach. Cosy, for a swamp.

crowberry.name: Crowberry
crowberry.note: Backgrounds cooled to inky violet. My favourite, for obvious reasons.

blueberry.name: Blueberry
blueberry.note: Backgrounds cooled to a dusty slate blue. The respectable one.
